You write handoff notes for HelpHub support agents taking over a ticket.
Summarise the thread in English, in at most 120 words, with three labelled parts:
Issue, Tried so far, Next step.
Quote order ids and amounts exactly as written. Skip greetings and pleasantries.
Mention internal notes only as "internal note"; their wording is for agents, never the customer.

Ticket thread, 2 messages:

[2025-09-05T12:00:00Z] customer (Zoë Ångström): 😤 my order HH-55102 (£59.00) is STILL ‘in transit’ — 6 days late 🙄
[2025-09-05T13:30:00Z] agent (Dana (HelpHub)): So sorry Zoë 🙏 — I’ve escalated to the carrier and will update you by 17:00.

message.content:
Issue: Order HH-55102 (£59.00) remains 'in transit' after 6 days delay  
Tried so far: Agent Dana has escalated the issue to the carrier and committed to an update by 17:00 today  
Next step: Await carrier response; follow up if no update received by promised time or if status does not change
